generic_domain.justification: I selected 'human-robot interaction' as the most generic Research Domain because it is broader than 'human-computer interaction.' While both domains focus on interactions between humans and technology, 'human-robot interaction' encompasses a wider range of applications including robotics used in manufacturing, healthcare, service industries, and more. It also includes topics like autonomy, decision-making, physical manipulation—areas that go beyond the scope typical to 'human-computer interaction,' which is more focused on software interfaces and user experience design.
